what: With the section pinned while scrolling, file-name chips fall from the top in a shuffled order and bounce on the floor (1.5 beats, eighth-note spacing), stacking into a pile that gets shorter toward the top, after ten beats all are sucked into the center and vanish at .2x (sixteenth-note spacing), and in their place a capsule bounces up from .92x and grows
